Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class ToolkitPack

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.ToolkitPack
public final class ToolkitPack extends Object
One named toolkit pack: ordered CSS and JS asset paths, the packs it depends on, its ToolkitPack.Kind, and the resolver that turns each path into a URL.

Register one through ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder.registerToolkitPack(ToolkitPack). A pack registered under an existing name replaces that pack completely, including its dependsOn.

Example:

ToolkitPack.create("datatables-export") .js(jszip, pdfmake, vfsFonts) .dependsOn("datatables-buttons") .kind(ToolkitPack.Kind.VENDOR) .resolver(myResolver) .build();

Since:
10.0.0
